svg.title: Enes K. Ergin, PhD
svg.desc: Bioinformatician in Vancouver: proteomics, gene fusions, and fast tools with a small footprint. Behind the name, one ridge per year of weekly GitHub contributions from 2014 to November 2026, newest in front; 4,013 contributions in 2026 so far.
